summary: You take STS 1, six disciplinary courses (four in social science and humanities, two in engineering and science, one of them a Global course that also counts toward those), a WIM course and a capstone, each with a C or better, and one concentration of at least 50 units, for 76 units. Every course must be letter graded and taken for at least 3 units, and a course counts toward either the core or the concentration, not both. The Associate Director's approval of your plan and of each concentration course, the C average in your Concentration Core, a self-designed concentration, and using only one of CS 105 and CS 106A across the degree are checked by hand.
